Name: Sanrio Cute Hats - Fashion Sense
Author: Jolamods
Description:
[center][size=6][color=#f1b9d3][b]♡ Sanrio Cute Hats ♡[/b][/color][/size]
[size=3]Tiny hats. Soft colours. A little Sanrio magic for your farmer.[/size]
Main: English • Translations: Español · 简体中文 · 日本語[/center]

[center][color=#c6b5df]୨୧ ────────── ♡ ────────── ୨୧[/color][/center]
[size=4][b]ENGLISH[/b][/size]
Dress your farmer in five little plush-style Sanrio hats, drawn for Stardew Valley's pixel world. A curved opening follows the fringe, temples and back of the head, keeping the face visible. Each hat has four directional views and a gentle walking animation.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53720/53720-1792086741-2115133680.png[/img]
[b]Meet the hats[/b]
• [b]Hello Kitty[/b] — a white kitty cap with her little pink bow.
• [b]Cinnamoroll[/b] — a soft white cap with blue details and floppy ears.
• [b]Pompompurin[/b] — warm yellow, tiny ears and a chocolate-brown beret.
• [b]Kuromi[/b] — a dark hood, pointed ears and a pink skull detail.
• [b]My Melody[/b] — a pink hood with sweet bunny ears.

[center][size=4][color=#cbbce7][b]♡ How to wear ♡[/b][/color][/size][/center]
Use [b]Fashion Sense's Hand Mirror[/b], sold at Pierre's shop. Select [b]Hats[/b], open the search menu and search [b]Sanrio[/b]. Choose your favourite hat. These are Fashion Sense appearances, not inventory hats or crafting recipes. Hair remains visible; the hats hide while swimming or wearing bathing clothes.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53720/53720-1792086744-2011547738.png[/img]
[b]Requirements[/b]
• Stardew Valley [b]PC 1.6.14+[/b] and a compatible [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] version (4.1.0+).
• [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url] [b]7.5.0+[/b], installed separately.
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53720/53720-1792086745-1103495651.png[/img]
[b]Installation[/b]
1. Close the game and extract the [b]main file[/b].
2. Place [b][FS] Sanrio Cute Hats[/b] inside Stardew Valley/Mods.
3. Launch the game through SMAPI and use the mirror.
When updating, replace the previous pack; do not keep duplicate folders. A new save is not required.

[center][size=4][color=#efb5ce][b]♡ English · 简体中文 · 日本語 ♡[/b][/color][/size][/center]
[b]Main File — English:[/b] the complete Fashion Sense hat pack. Install this first.
[b]Spanish Translation — Español:[/b] optional display-name translation for the Spanish game language.
[b]Chinese Translation — 简体中文:[/b] optional display-name translation for the Chinese game language.
[b]Japanese Translation — 日本語:[/b] optional display-name translation for the Japanese game language.
Each translation requires the English Main File, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] 2.9.0+ and SMAPI 4.1.10+. Put its [CP] folder next to [FS] Sanrio Cute Hats and keep both. [b]Install only one translation.[/b] Remove other translation folders, including the old combined pack, before switching. Names follow the game's language, with English fallback. Original appearance IDs and saved outfits are preserved. Search Sanrio or the character's local/English name in the mirror.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53720/53720-1792086748-1284963054.png[/img]
[b]Notes[/b]
Tested with Stardew Valley 1.6.15, SMAPI 4.5.2 and Fashion Sense 7.5.0, including both farmer bodies, four directions, walking poses and six vanilla hairstyles. Custom bodies, every modded hairstyle and multiplayer sessions have not been comprehensively tested. Other mods may alter the fit.
To remove the main pack, clear the hat in the mirror first, close the game and remove its folder. The optional translation pack can be removed independently.
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53720/53720-1792086751-1902505873.png[/img]
[b]Credits[/b]
Mod by [b]Joel / Jolamods[/b]. Fashion Sense by PeacefulEnd / Floogen; Content Patcher by Pathoschild. Gallery images are cropped and enlarged gameplay screenshots. The cover title uses AI-generated artwork.
Unofficial fan mod. Sanrio characters belong to Sanrio; Stardew Valley belongs to ConcernedApe. Not affiliated with or endorsed by either.
